entities.name: Gwendolyn Carthalion
entities.description: A blue mage born Gwendolyn Mor, daughter of Grenfell Mor, wife of Adam Carthalion and mother of Jared Carthalion, sacrificed to Ravidel.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Gwendolyn's husband, who sacrificed her in his quest to become a planeswalker.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Gwendolyn's son, born in the Spring of 4180 AR.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A so-called god to whom Gwendolyn was sacrificed.

entities.name: Castle Melmereth
entities.description: The castle with a sculpture of Gwendolyn above the Carthalion throne.

events.summary: Gwendolyn gives birth to Jared Carthalion in the Spring of 4180 AR.
events.quote: Gwendolyn gave birth to Jared Carthalion in the Spring of 4180 AR

events.summary: Adam sacrifices Gwendolyn to the god Ravidel in his quest to become a planeswalker.
